en: Ask your own questions of the country data: compare groups of countries and see which pairs differ, check whether two measures move together, see which factors still matter once others are held constant, or follow how fast countries ratify a treaty. Every answer sets out the null and alternative hypotheses, the test used, the p-value and whether the null hypothesis is rejected at the significance level you choose, with a 95% interval and a plain reading. You can also take the p-value from a permutation test, which reshuffles the data thousands of times instead of assuming a random sample.

en: Going to a trusted person rather than a government office is not a sign of ignorance. In fieldwork with Beth Lyon of Cornell Law School in two farmworker communities in rural West Java, I found that people understand their rights through their relationships with family, neighbors and respected figures. Beth Lyon and I call this the “relational self”. Justice is not imagined as an abstract right claimed alone before the state; it is pursued together, through people one trusts.
id: Mendatangi orang yang dipercaya, bukan kantor dinas, bukan tanda ketidaktahuan. Dalam penelitian lapangan bersama Beth Lyon dari Cornell Law School di dua komunitas buruh tani di pedesaan Jawa Barat, saya menemukan bahwa orang memahami haknya melalui hubungan dengan keluarga, tetangga, dan orang yang dihormati. Saya dan Beth Lyon menyebutnya “diri relasional”. Keadilan tidak dibayangkan sebagai hak abstrak yang diklaim seorang diri di depan negara, tetapi diupayakan bersama, lewat orang-orang yang dipercaya.

en: Indonesia’s law on the protection of migrant workers was written with a different picture in mind. Law No. 18 of 2017 and the UN Migrant Workers Convention, which Indonesia ratified through Law No. 6 of 2012, assume a worker who reads the contract, knows their rights and complains in their own name. In practice, the law reaches workers only when an intermediary has mastered it: paralegals and advocates at legal aid institutes, officers of migrant worker organizations, staff of local manpower offices and one-stop service centers, village officials, and officials in ministries and at Indonesian missions abroad.

en: International initiatives have not helped much either. Most migration indexes and databases are designed, funded and run from the most developed countries, so their questions are those countries’ questions: asylum, integration, naturalization and control of arrivals. The issues closest to Indonesian workers, such as placement-fee debt, work permits tied to a single employer, the exclusion of domestic workers and farmworkers from labor law, and the role of countries of origin, receive little attention. Almost none were designed with a village in Cianjur or a district office in Indramayu in mind.
id: Inisiatif internasional juga belum banyak menolong. Persoalan yang paling dekat dengan pekerja kita, seperti utang biaya penempatan, izin kerja yang terikat pada satu majikan, pengecualian pekerja rumah tangga dan buruh tani dari hukum ketenagakerjaan, serta peran negara asal, kurang mendapat tempat. en: Legal education in Indonesia still rests on the interpretation of provisions and doctrine, while questions about how law works in practice are seldom tested with data. Every rule and decision in IMR’s databases is coded on the same variables, with a codebook and its sources, so that students can write undergraduate, master’s and doctoral theses that test legal questions in measurable ways. Comparative law courses can also look to the Philippines, South Africa, Kenya or Colombia, countries whose problems are closer to Indonesia’s. University law clinics can use all these tools in practice, and help check the data at the same time.
id: Pendidikan hukum kita masih bertumpu pada tafsir pasal dan doktrin, sementara pertanyaan tentang bagaimana hukum bekerja dalam kenyataan jarang diuji dengan data. Setiap aturan dan putusan dalam basis data IMR diberi kode menurut variabel yang sama, disertai buku kode dan sumbernya, sehingga mahasiswa bisa menulis skripsi, tesis, dan disertasi yang menguji pertanyaan hukum secara terukur. Mata kuliah perbandingan hukum pun bisa menengok Filipina, Afrika Selatan, Kenya, atau Kolombia, negara yang persoalannya lebih mirip dengan kita. Klinik hukum kampus bisa memakai semua alat ini sebagai bahan praktik, sekaligus membantu memeriksa data.

en: The Countries of Origin page sets Indonesia beside the Philippines, Vietnam, Nepal, Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan on nine questions, from the licensing of placement agencies and fees to restrictions on departure and reintegration. Ministries can use it when drafting implementing regulations or considering a revision of Law No. 18 of 2017. The pages on countries of destination, from domestic workers in Hong Kong and fishing crews in Taiwan to the legal frameworks of the Gulf states, can serve as starting material for bilateral negotiations.

Kementerian bisa memakainya ketika menyusun peraturan pelaksana atau menimbang revisi UU 18/2017. Halaman tentang negara tujuan, dari pekerja rumah tangga di Hong Kong dan awak kapal ikan Taiwan sampai kerangka hukum negara-negara Teluk, bisa menjadi bahan awal perundingan bilateral.

en: The Court Decisions database holds more than 1,500 decisions from Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America, searchable by the arguments judges accepted or rejected. An advocate suing a placement agency, for example, can see how Philippine courts have held agencies jointly liable with employers abroad. The directory of free legal help helps refer victims to organizations in the country where they work, and the ratification and comparison data can be cited in shadow reports to the UN Committee on Migrant Workers.

Advokat yang menggugat perusahaan penempatan, misalnya, bisa melihat bagaimana pengadilan Filipina membebankan tanggung jawab bersama kepada agen dan majikan di luar negeri. Direktori bantuan hukum gratis membantu merujuk korban ke organisasi di negara tempatnya bekerja, dan data ratifikasi serta perbandingan bisa dikutip dalam laporan bayangan kepada Komite Pekerja Migran PBB.

en: The consequences show in many decisions. Policy is often a reaction to whichever case is in the news, such as a temporary halt to placements, without being weighed against the experience of other countries of origin. Restrictions on women’s departure are still seen as protection, although the CEDAW Committee’s General Recommendation No. 26 regards them as discrimination. Memoranda of understanding are negotiated without a comparison table. Civil society campaigns often borrow frameworks from Europe or North America, while complaints to international mechanisms are seldom tried because few people know which doors are open.
id: Akibatnya terlihat dalam banyak keputusan. Kebijakan sering lahir sebagai reaksi atas kasus yang sedang ramai, misalnya penghentian sementara penempatan, tanpa ditimbang terhadap pengalaman negara asal lain. Pembatasan keberangkatan bagi perempuan masih dianggap pelindungan, padahal Rekomendasi Umum No. 26 Komite CEDAW memandangnya sebagai diskriminasi. Nota kesepahaman dirundingkan tanpa tabel pembanding. Kampanye masyarakat sipil kerap meminjam kerangka dari Eropa atau Amerika Utara, sementara pengaduan ke mekanisme internasional jarang dicoba karena tidak banyak yang tahu pintu mana yang terbuka.

en: The labor laws of the UAE, Bahrain and Oman cover farm workers employed by companies, while farm and livestock workers employed by a household or private owner fall under domestic-worker law. Saudi Arabia regulates farm workers and private herders employed by individuals in a separate 2025 regulation. Qatar excludes farming and grazing work from its labor law, except in establishments that process and market their own produce. Kuwait's law has no farm provision.

Arab Saudi mengatur buruh tani dan penggembala yang dipekerjakan perorangan dalam peraturan tersendiri tahun 2025. Qatar mengecualikan kerja pertanian dan penggembalaan dari UU ketenagakerjaannya, kecuali di usaha yang mengolah dan memasarkan hasilnya sendiri. UU Kuwait tidak memuat ketentuan tentang pertanian.

en: The national tier covers a selection of frameworks chosen for the size of their migrant or hired farm workforce or the influence of their model. It is a selection, not a census.
